answer_3.quote: For the zero-shot setup, we prompt llama3.2vision, llava-llama3, and minicpm-v. We prompt each model five times and report results averaged across runs.

answer_4.quote: Participants are asked to provide a social media post using one of three data collection strategies -CREATION, DONATION, and RECENT -and then annotate it.
answer_4.guideline: Table 1: Wording and response options for survey questions used in the analysis. [Emo.] refers to Anger, Disgust, Fear, Joy, Sadness, Surprise. [Time] refers to one of Seconds, Minutes, Days, Weeks, Months.
